oidcc-unsigned-request-object-supported-: FAILED — provider silently ignores the request parameter (DOT has no JAR support): the suite puts state/nonce inside the request object only, so the response is missing state and the id_token nonce mismatches. OIDC Core 1.0 s6.1 says an OP without request support should return the request_not_supported error; implementing that rejection in AuthAuthorizationView would turn this module green.
oidcc-ensure-request-object-with-redirec: FAILED — same DOT JAR gap: the request object carries the redirect_uri, the provider ignores the object entirely and completes the flow from the plain query parameters, so the rejection (or redirect_uri error page) the suite expects never happens. The request_not_supported rejection above would green this module too.
